query:
# Properties whose symmetric constraint (Q21510862) or inverse constraint
# (Q21510855) lists exceptions (P2303), with the number of listed exceptions.
# The symmetric constraint on P26 lists none (p26-constraints, 2026-11-14).
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT ?property ?propertyLabel ?type ?typeLabel ?status ?statusLabel
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?exception) AS ?exceptions) WHERE {
  VALUES ?type { wd:Q21510862 wd:Q21510855 }
  ?property p:P2302 ?c .
  ?c ps:P2302 ?type .
  ?c pq:P2303 ?exception .
  OPTIONAL { ?c pq:P2316 ?status }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
GROUP BY ?property ?propertyLabel ?type ?typeLabel ?status ?statusLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?exceptions)
